notes: The module library. Each module is a screen or feature the generator knows how to build. 'order' sets navigation order. 'deep_link_tool' names the existing_tools type that, when the business already uses one, turns the module into a link to that tool instead of a rebuilt copy.

modules.name: Home
modules.summary: Landing screen: logo, tagline, open/closed badge and big quick-action buttons (call, directions, order or book).
modules.build_spec: Hero with logo (or the business name set in the brand font), tagline, an open-now badge computed from hours, and 2-4 quick-action buttons chosen from the plan's modules (Call, Directions, Order, Book, Get a quote). Show the current special or announcement if one exists.

modules.name: About
modules.summary: The business story, what makes it different, and founding year.
modules.build_spec: Short story from business.description, a list of differentiators, and the founding year if known. No invented history.

modules.name: Contact
modules.summary: Tap-to-call, text, email, address with directions, and social links.
modules.build_spec: tel:, sms: and mailto: buttons for whatever contact info exists, the address with a Directions button (Google Maps link built from the address; skip it when address_is_public is false) and icons for each social profile.

modules.name: Hours
modules.summary: Weekly hours with today highlighted and a live open-now indicator.
modules.build_spec: Seven-day table with today highlighted, open/closed now computed on the device clock (handle split shifts and past-midnight closing), and the hours notes (holidays, seasonal changes).

modules.name: Menu
modules.summary: Food or drink menu by category, with prices and dietary tags.
modules.build_spec: Category tabs or chips, item cards with name, description and price, dietary/specialty tag filters, and a search box when there are more than 25 items. Prices shown exactly as given; never invent one.

modules.name: Order
modules.summary: Order online: a cart that sends a pickup order request, or a link to the ordering service they already use.
modules.build_spec: Native mode: add-to-cart from the menu or catalog, a cart with quantities and notes, pickup time picker, and a Send Order button that opens a pre-filled SMS or email to the business (no payments). Deep-link mode: one clear Order Online button to the existing provider plus delivery-platform buttons.

modules.name: Specials
modules.summary: Daily or weekly specials and announcements the owner can update.
modules.build_spec: A list of specials/announcements with optional date ranges; expired ones hide automatically. Seed it from research only if specials were found, otherwise show an owner placeholder.

modules.name: Reserve
modules.summary: Table reservation request, or a link to their existing reservation system.
modules.build_spec: Native mode: party size, date, time and name/phone, sent as a pre-filled SMS or email request, clearly labeled as a request until the business confirms. Deep-link mode: a Reserve button to the existing provider.

modules.name: Book
modules.summary: Book an appointment: pick a service and preferred time, or jump to the booking tool they already use.
modules.build_spec: Native mode: choose service (from services list), optional staff member, preferred date and time window within business hours, name and phone, sent as a pre-filled SMS or email request. Deep-link mode: a Book Now button to the existing booking provider, shown on the home screen too.

modules.name: Services
modules.summary: Services with descriptions, price ranges and durations.
modules.build_spec: Grouped service cards with description and price or 'Call for pricing' when no price is known. Each card has a Book or Quote button when those modules are in the plan.

modules.name: Team
modules.summary: Team member cards with roles and specialties (owner-provided).
modules.build_spec: Cards with photo placeholder, first name, role and specialties. Content comes from the owner only; research never fills this with names.

modules.name: Gallery
modules.summary: Photo grid of products, food or the space (owner uploads).
modules.build_spec: Responsive photo grid with a full-screen viewer and swipe. Uses owner-supplied images only; shows labeled placeholders until they are added.

modules.name: Our Work
modules.summary: Before/after project showcase for trades and creative work.
modules.build_spec: Project cards with title, service type, location (town only) and a before/after slider when two images exist. Owner-supplied images only.

modules.name: Get a Quote
modules.summary: Quote request form: what they need, details, photos, and how to reach them.
modules.build_spec: Form with service type (from services), description, address or town, preferred contact method and optional photos; submits as a pre-filled email (photos attached by the customer) or SMS. Deep-link mode if they already use a quote form provider.

modules.name: Service Area
modules.summary: Towns and areas covered, with a quick 'do you serve my area?' check.
modules.build_spec: List of covered towns/areas and a search box that matches the customer's town against the list, with a Call to Confirm fallback.

modules.name: Shop
modules.summary: Product catalog by category with inquiry or buy links.
modules.build_spec: Product grid with categories, search, price and availability text, and an Ask About This button (SMS/email). Deep-link mode links each product or the whole catalog to their existing online store.

modules.name: Rewards
modules.summary: Digital punch card customers show at checkout.
modules.build_spec: Punch card stored on the device; staff add a stamp by entering the shop's 4-digit code set in the app's settings. Reward text set by the owner. State clearly that it is a simple honor-system card, not a payment system. Deep-link mode if they already run a loyalty program.

modules.name: Reviews
modules.summary: Rating summary with links to leave or read reviews on Google, Facebook or Yelp.
modules.build_spec: Show the rating and review count with its source, Leave a Review buttons for each review platform found, and a testimonials list that only shows quotes the owner supplies. Never write or paraphrase reviews as testimonials.

modules.name: Events
modules.summary: Upcoming events, classes or pop-ups with add-to-calendar.
modules.build_spec: Upcoming list grouped by month with date, time, place and description; past events hide automatically; each has an Add to Calendar (.ics download) button.

modules.name: Schedule
modules.summary: Weekly class, session or service-time timetable.
modules.build_spec: Day-by-day timetable with class/session name, time, instructor or leader (owner-provided) and a Sign Up or Book link when available.

modules.name: Listings
modules.summary: Property listings with photos, price and an inquiry button.
modules.build_spec: Listing cards with photo placeholder, price, beds/baths/sqft, address (town only unless the owner adds more) and Ask About This Property. Seeded empty; the owner or their listing feed fills it.

modules.name: FAQ
modules.summary: Answers to common questions (parking, payment, policies).
modules.build_spec: Accordion of questions and answers. Seed only with questions whose answers came from research (for example payment methods, parking, allergy policy); everything else is an owner placeholder.

modules.name: Give
modules.summary: Giving or donation link for churches and nonprofits.
modules.build_spec: A Give button linking to their existing giving page or payment link (never collect card details in the app), plus the mission statement.

modules.name: Emergency
modules.summary: One-tap urgent call for 24/7 or emergency services.
modules.build_spec: A large, high-contrast Call Now button pinned to the top of the home screen, with the after-hours note. Only included when the business advertises emergency or 24/7 service.

modules.name: Forms
modules.summary: Links to new-client or intake forms the business already hosts.
modules.build_spec: List of forms with a short description each, linking out to the business's existing secure form or patient/client portal. The app never collects health, legal or financial details itself.
